title: Dispatch parallel agents for 2+ independent tasks
body: Whenever 2+ independent tasks can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies, invoke the superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents skill and fan out Task tool calls in a single message.
example: User: '跑 lint, tests, changelog 三件事' → Assistant: Skill(superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents) → three Task tool_use blocks in one message.
